full_prompt_en: A square painterly close-up fills the frame with a young child's face against a dark green and brown background. The crop cuts through the top of the head and approaches the chin, leaving very little setting around the subject. Soft brown hair falls in fine loose strands across the forehead and along both cheeks. A pale fabric accent appears near the upper-right edge, while a white ruffled garment rises beneath the chin and fills the lower-right corner. The face turns only slightly toward the viewer and looks straight outward. Large green eyes occupy the upper middle of the image; small bright reflections make their irises clear, and darker lashes define the lids without heavy outlines. Warm peach and apricot tones model the cheeks, nose, and forehead, with a deeper rosy flush below the eyes and along the lower cheeks. The small nose has a soft highlight on its bridge and tip. Glossy coral-red lips sit near the lower center, their highlights sharper than the blended skin around them. The left side of the head merges gradually into rich shadow, while the right cheek, nose, and white fabric receive brighter light. The background is left broad and indistinct: deep green shows at the lower left, nearly black brown at the upper left, and no separate objects or readable words appear. Smooth transitions shape the facial planes, but small visible brush marks and softened edges preserve the painted surface. A directional, gentle light comes from the upper right, catching the eyes and lips and giving the white ruffles cool pale highlights. The overall composition is intimate and still, balancing luminous green eyes and warm skin against dense, quiet shadow and a small area of bright cloth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式近景以幼童的面孔填满画面，背景为深绿和褐色。取景切过头顶并接近下巴，人物周围几乎不留具体场景。柔软棕发以细小松散发丝垂在额前和两颊旁。右上边缘露出一小片浅色布料装饰，白色褶饰衣服在下巴下方升起，占满右下角。面孔只微微转向观看者，目光正向画外。绿色大眼睛位于上部中央，小小亮点使虹膜清晰，深色睫毛界定眼睑，却没有沉重勾线。暖桃色和杏色塑造脸颊、鼻子及额头，眼下和下颊带有更深的玫瑰红晕。小鼻子的鼻梁和鼻尖有柔和高光。珊瑚红而湿亮的嘴唇位于下方中央，唇部高光比周围晕开的肤色更清楚。头部左侧逐渐融入浓重阴影，右侧脸颊、鼻子和白布料则受较亮的光。背景保持宽阔而模糊：左下有深绿，左上近乎黑褐，没有分明的其他物件或可读文字。平滑过渡塑出面部体面，细小可见笔迹和软化边缘仍保留绘画表面。温柔的定向光从右上方落下，抓住眼睛与嘴唇，让白色褶饰带有偏冷的浅亮高光。整体构图亲密而静止，以发亮的绿眼睛和暖色皮肤平衡浓密安静的阴影及一小片明亮衣料。
style_prompt_en: The painterly image combines finely blended tonal transitions with selective, precise highlights. Warm peach, apricot, coral, and pale cream stand forward against deep green-brown and near-black fields, allowing small cool green accents to become focal points. Rounded forms emerge gradually from shadow rather than being enclosed by continuous hard lines. Fine loose strokes appear at the edges and in soft textures, while smoother central passages retain luminous depth. Highlights are concentrated on a few reflective areas and pale folds; surrounding colors remain quiet and velvety. Directional soft light brightens one side, leaving the other side to dissolve into a dark, low-detail ground. The framing is close and asymmetrical, so a compact bright center has strong emotional presence without decorative background detail. The overall effect is tender and vivid, with controlled focus, gentle paint texture, and warm-cool color contrast doing the visual work.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画式影像把细致晕染的明度过渡与选择性、准确的高光结合起来。暖桃色、杏色、珊瑚红与浅奶油色从深绿褐及近黑色域前浮出，让少量冷绿色重音成为焦点。圆润形体从阴影中渐渐显现，而不是被连续硬线框住。边缘和柔软肌理里出现细小松散笔迹，较平滑的中央区域则保留发亮的深度。高光集中在少数反光处和浅色褶面；周围色彩保持安静、如丝绒般柔暗。柔和的定向光提亮一侧，另一侧则消失在细节稀少的暗底面里。取景紧密而不对称，使紧凑明亮的中心无需背景装饰也具有强烈的情感存在感。整体效果温柔鲜活，由受控焦点、轻柔颜料肌理和冷暖色彩反差承担视觉表现。
theme_en: A close portrait of a young child with green eyes against a deep dark background
theme_zh: 深色背景前一位绿眼幼童的近距离肖像
name: Donald Zolan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
